verdict: THE PATCH EXTENDS REACH — BREADTH UP, NEW-GENE PRECISION LOW (honest tradeoff). The genome-wide screen takes the measured causal engine from 2,058 to 9867 pieces (+7813 genes now measured, not inferred). Essential precision is PRESERVED (biology recovery 16% off -> 16% on, searching 4.8x more candidates). The NEW gwps-only genes are only WEAKLY informative (1% vs 0% random) — a measured but noisy fingerprint, exactly the coverage/precision tradeoff the genome-wide screen carries. So: every causal syscall now REACHES 9,871 pieces (vs 2,058), high-confidence for the essential 2,058 and low-confidence (flagged) for the rest — real added breadth, honestly the opposite of high precision. Still the right move: a weak measured answer beats the inference null (causal_reach/causal_patch), as long as the confidence is labelled.
